facts.business: Superior Industrial Enterprises Limited is an Indian listed company with property, plant and equipment including factory building, plant & machinery, and investments in subsidiaries and other entities.

capacity_or_capex.item: Additions to Property, Plant and Equipment (Plant & Machinery, Electronic Equipment, Computer)

auditor.name: S. Jain & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Fair valuation of investments as on reporting date based on previous financial year and financial statements of investee companies (Note No. 4). Opinion not modified.

key_risks: Fair valuation of investments dependent on prior year financial statements of investee companies
Estimation uncertainty in impairment of property, plant and equipment
Estimation of defined benefit obligations based on actuarial assumptions
Estimation of deferred tax assets for carry forward losses
Impairment of trade receivables based on expected credit loss estimates
Fair value measurement of financial instruments using valuation techniques with unobservable inputs
facts.related_party_note: Annexure-V refers to disclosure of particulars of contracts/arrangements entered into by the company with related parties (AOC-2) referred to in sub-section (1) of section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 including certain arm's length transactions under fourth proviso thereto.
